New decision "Chose one oneLine() normaliser — collapse \s+ to a space, trim, strip URL userinfo, cap with an ellipsis, blank → absent — applied to EVERY free-text field the working-set renderer emits, with two caps: RESULT_RENDER_MAX 240 for observation-derived text and PROSE_RENDER_MAX 500 for ruling statement, decision summary/rationale, post summary and entity name" relates to:
- 01M2P2DNHYXMKK2H492Y46KHZA: "Chose revision tokens `base..head` / `@head` / `since base` with `revision <token>` on the scope line and `over <range>` on the observed line, replacing the `..head` / `base..` forms"
- 01M2P2EKXE8574ER9W9Q9EXBF1: "Chose to EXCLUDE the hooks' own session_start / compaction / post_compaction observations from the working set (alongside principal, membership, receipt) rather than render them compactly or rank them below proposals"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 2 existing decision(s) overlap
